title: THE SHUKENJA - the holy man: the Wisdom doctrine with the spell-failure ladder, the three-part training with the ki save power, the ethos experience rules, the religious restrictions and the family severance, Tables 26, 27 and 28
audit_comment: OA round eleven (capture pp. 42-45): the shukenja - the Wisdom minima and bonus, the training and ki, the ethos rules, and the advancement, Wisdom and spell grids

banner.title: THE SHUKENJA, printed capture pp. 42-45 - the OA shukenja round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 42-45 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). The T26 row-1 and row-12 xp bounds are OCR-mangled in the capture (0-1 250 and 1,200,00) and settled against the 2018 print BEFORE pinning (1,250 and 1,200,000) per the settling doctrine. The T27 spell-bonus column pins as cumulative codes and the T28 dashes pin as zeros. OCR normalization: minimum scares reads as minimum scores; principal attitude reads as principal attribute; t has failed reads as it has failed (prose only)

bools.name: dgkShukenjaGoodOnly
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 43): must have good alignment - lawful, neutral or chaotic

bools.name: dgkShukenjaOutsideCaste
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 43): the self-sacrifice places him outside the caste system, respected by all members of society

bools.name: dgkShukenjaClericTables
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 44): the combat and saving throw tables of clerics

bools.name: dgkShukenjaStuddedLeatherCap
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 44): limited to studded leather or lesser armor, though certain individual pieces can be worn

bools.name: dgkShukenjaReligionSlot
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 44): one of the four non-weapon slots must be religion

bools.name: dgkShukenjaCalligraphySlot
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 44): another slot must be calligraphy

bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 44): the ritual training - marriages, christenings, funeral rites, holy days and purifications

bools.name: dgkShukenjaSanctifyNoStack
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 44): multiple purifications have no cumulative effect

bools.name: dgkShukenjaMeditationAware
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 44): meditating, he is oblivious to hunger, thirst, heat and cold but suffers no surprise or initiative penalties

bools.name: dgkShukenjaFreeStyle
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 45): the self-defense training gives a free initial unarmed-combat style outside the slots

bools.name: dgkShukenjaKiBeforeDieRolled
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 45): the ki decision can be made any point in the round unless the save die is already rolled

bools.name: dgkShukenjaEvilSpiritFullXp

bools.name: dgkShukenjaDonatedTreasureXp

bools.name: dgkShukenjaNoMeat
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 45): cannot eat meat, must refrain from violence whenever possible, avoid immoderate drinking and eating

bools.name: dgkShukenjaNoOrganizedChurch
bools.comment: Shukenja prose (capture p. 44): no separate organized church - the temples are more or less independent, the beliefs intermingled

tables.name: dgkT26Grid
tables.comment: the Table 26 shukenja advancement grid (capture p. 42)
col_comments: the experience column: the upper xp bound of each level, 1,250 at 1st to 1,200,000 at 12th - the row-1 and row-12 bounds OCR-mangled in the capture (0-1 250 and 1,200,00) and settled against the 2018 print (capture p. 42).
the accumulated d6 dice column: one per level through 9th, then held at 9 (capture p. 42).
the hit-point bonus column: the printed 9-plus-N cells - 1 hp per level beyond 9th: 0 through 9th, then 1, 2, 3 (capture p. 42).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 26 grid: the xp bounds and the accumulated dice plus bonus (capture p. 42)

tables.name: dgkT27Grid
tables.comment: the Table 27 shukenja Wisdom adjustments grid (capture p. 43)
col_comments: the spell-bonus code column: 0 none through Wisdom 12, then one additional 1st-level spell at 13-14 (code 1), one 2nd at 15-16 (code 2), one 3rd at 17 (code 3), one 4th at 18 (code 4) - cumulative (capture p. 43).
the spell-failure column: the percent chance a cast spell fails - 20 at Wisdom 9 down to 0 at 13 and above (capture p. 43).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 27 grid: the spell-bonus codes and the failure ladder (capture p. 43)

tables.name: dgkT28Grid
tables.comment: the Table 28 shukenja spells usable by level grid (capture pp. 43-44)
col_comments: the 1st-level spells column: 1 at 1st to 9 from 22nd (capture pp. 43-44).
the 2nd-level spells column: none until 4th, then 1 to 9 from 25th (capture pp. 43-44).
the 3rd-level spells column: none until 6th, then 1 to 9 from 28th (capture pp. 43-44).
the 4th-level spells column: none until 8th, then 1 to 9 at 29th (capture pp. 43-44).
the 5th-level spells column: none until 10th, then 1 to 8 at 29th (capture pp. 43-44).
the 6th-level spells column: none until 14th, then 1 to 7 at 29th (capture pp. 43-44).
the 7th-level spells column: none until 18th, then 1 to 5 at 29th (capture pp. 43-44).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 28 grid: the seven spell-level columns, levels 1-29 (capture pp. 43-44)

table_checks.note: the T26 first row - 1,250 xp, one die (settled against the 2018 print; capture p. 42)
the T26 capstone - 1,200,000 xp, nine dice plus three (settled; capture p. 42)
the T26 9-plus-N cells open on the 10th-level row (capture p. 42)
the T27 failure ladder - 20 at Wis 9 down to 0 at 13 (capture p. 43)
the T27 bonus tiers - none through 12, the 1st at 13, the 4th at 18 (capture p. 43)
the T27 spell minima - Wis 17 for the 6th, 18 for the 7th (capture p. 43)
the T28 1st-level row - one 1st-level spell only (capture p. 43)
the T28 capstone - the 29th-level row (capture p. 44)
the T28 openings - the 2nd at 4th, the 3rd at 6th, the 7th at 18th (capture pp. 43-44)
the purification ladder - 5 percent per level, the 75-square-foot circle (capture p. 44)
the Wisdom-15 example - two bonus 1st and one bonus 2nd cumulatively, the 2nd usable from 4th level (capture p. 43)
the meditation and ki ladders - the 2-to-1 rest, the +3 save (capture pp. 44-45)
